title: Nourishing Silky Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A peppery and silky Algerian dish featuring plum jam, this lamb tagine is a show-off recipe that is low-fat-friendly and perfect for special occasions. It is made with tender lamb, flavorful spices, and sweet plum jam.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the plum jam and 1 cup of water, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the tagine or Dutch oven and transfer it to the oven, where it will cook at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Traditionally, the tagine is served with crusty bread or over couscous.
You can also serve it with a side of steamed vegetables or a simple green salad.
